Something not working in BC250 Control Center, or an idea to make it better? Tell me here. It takes about 3 minutes and you do not need an account.

Fastest way (Control Center 1.21.2 and newer): press "Report this problem" on any error window, or open Settings > Diagnostics > "Send a report". The app sends this form for you with the error code, where it happened, the raw error and your system already filled in. Older versions: Settings > Diagnostics > "Copy for a problem report", then paste it in "Diagnostics report" on the next page.

Any language is fine. Only I can see the answers.
Need a faster reply? @movacx on Telegram, _movacx on Discord.
BC250 community forum on Discord: https://discordapp.com/channels/1315924807128449065/1526169299490836510
